sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: MDR conferral assay: insertion at 101 did NOT alter P-gp function; immunofluorescence of intact cells confirmed extracellular display of the tag.
sites.rationale: Position 101 falls within ECL1 (topology landmarks 73-119), 29 residues from TM1-end (72) and 19 residues from TM2-start (120), well clear of both TM boundaries. The paper explicitly confirmed extracellular localization by immunofluorescence of intact cells and preserved MDR function. Python lookup: seq[101]=T, seq[102]=G. Full-length P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) with HA epitope inserted at position 101, expressed in Chinese hamster ovary cells; surface localization tested by immunofluorescence of intact (non-permeabilized) cells with anti-HA antibody 12CA5.

sources.claim: Functional integrity of the modified proteins was tested by measuring their capacity to confer MDR in Chinese hamster ovary cells. Intracellular and extracellular localization of the tag in the full-length protein was determined in intact or permeabilized cells by immunofluorescence using a mouse monoclonal antibody (12CA5) specific for the HA epitope. While insertions at positions 101, 161, 320, and 376 did not alter P-gp function, insertions at positions 206 and 244 abrogated the capacity of P-gp to confer drug resistance.

sources.claim: The epitope tags inserted at positions 161 and 376 were found to be located intracellularly, whereas the tags at positions 101 and 320 were located on the extracellular side of the membrane. These results indicate that the intervening segments separating predicted TM1-TM2 and TM5-TM6 correspond to extracellular regions, while the segments linking TM2-TM3 and the one located downstream of TM6 correspond to intracellular regions.

sources.claim: We have now inserted single epitope tags at positions 207, 235, 276, 741, 782, 797, 815, 849, 887, 961, and 1024; double epitope tags at positions 736, 849, and 961; and a triple epitope tag at position 849. sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell-surface HiBiT luminescence confirmed extracellular display of the tag in intact cells; used as a quantitative readout of plasma-membrane expression levels. MDR function: NOT MEASURED in this study.
sites.rationale: The paper reports HiBiT insertion in the '1st extracellular loop' of full-length ABCB1 (ECL1, topology landmarks 73-119) and confirms surface display by extracellular luminescence assay on intact cells. No specific residue number is given, so insert_after_residue is null and the site is region-level. The ΔY490 variant background does not affect ECL1 topology. This is a separate, independent insertion from the HA-tag studies at position 101 in the same loop. Full-length ΔY490-ABCB1 with HiBiT tag inserted in the 1st extracellular loop by PCR-based mutagenesis, expressed in 293MSR and BEAS-2B cells; cell-surface levels measured using NanoGlo HiBiT Extracellular system on intact cells.

sources.claim: T70-CFTR-HiBiT(Ex) was constructed by replacing the 3xHA tag with the HiBiT tag in the 4th extracellular loop of CFTR as previously [ 25 ]. ∆Y490-ABCB1-HiBiT(Ex) was constructed by inserting the HiBiT tag in the 1st extracellular loop by PCR-based mutagenesis and inserted to pLX304 (Addgene #25890) via LR reaction using LR clonase II enzyme mix (ThermoFisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA). pcDNA3-FLAG-His-UBE3C was constructed by inserting UBE3C cDNA into the pcDNA3.2 vector (ThermoFisher) by in-fusion cloning.

literature_notes: Six sites reported. Positions 101 and 320 (PMID 7535563) and 736, 741, 961 (PMID 8621583) are pinned to exact residues by HA-tag insertion studies in full-length membrane-anchored ABCB1; the ECL1 HiBiT site (PMC10706245) is region-level only. Position 849 was reported as extracellular by PMID 8621583 but falls within TM9 (833-853) per the authoritative computed topology landmarks; it is excluded from sites and noted below. Position 961 is 2 residues from TM11-end (959) per the landmarks, marginally below the ≥3 threshold, but the paper's direct immunofluorescence confirmation of extracellular display and preserved function in the full-length protein is retained; confidence is medium. Position 235 was reported intracellular by PMID 8621583 but falls in TM (120-138 per landmarks); the paper's intracellular call is consistent with TM burial. The ΔY490 deletion in the HiBiT construct (L4-L6) is in the intracellular NBD1 region and does not affect ECL1 topology or surface display.
